branchName: main (local commits in research/laya-eval only, never pushed)
description: Measure whether Laya can replace the clerk/Jev decider: latency on the Mac mini, zero-shot vs fine-tuned quality on real and synthetic states, robustness to schema changes. Rules in EVAL_PROTOCOL.md.

userStories.title: Latency benchmark on this Mac
userStories.description: Time the typed-decisions checkpoint on real states with our 10 questions, mps and cpu, full vs trimmed, max_len 512/1024/2048. Also extract clerk decision latency and wearer-facing delays from the backend logs.
acceptanceCriteria: results/latency.json exists with p50 and p90 per device, variant and max_len
results/latency.json records state token counts (median, max) for full and trimmed states
results/latency.json records clerk decision latency and voice/TTS latency from logs
REPORT.md has a Latency section

userStories.title: Rulebook, schema, validator
userStories.description: Write RULEBOOK.md (labeling policy for all 10 questions), SCHEMA.md (exact state and label format matching build_state), scripts/validate.py.
acceptanceCriteria: RULEBOOK.md covers all 8 yes/no questions plus topic and urgency with concrete rules and examples
scripts/validate.py exits 0 on a valid file and non-zero with a reason on an invalid one
validate.py accepts data/real_states.jsonl states (state part only)
userStories.notes: validate.py: real_states --state-only OK n=141; 8 deliberately broken lines fail with reasons.

userStories.title: Label the real test set
userStories.description: Label the 141 real states against RULEBOOK.md. Done by an agent that generates no training data.
acceptanceCriteria: data/real_test.jsonl has >= 72 labeled states including all 12 real escalations
validate.py passes on it
label yes-rates per question are printed into progress.txt

userStories.title: Generate synthetic states
userStories.description: Parallel generator agents write labeled states in the exact schema, seeded with real captions/objects, following RULEBOOK.md. Target 2000, minimum 600.
acceptanceCriteria: data/synth/batch_*.jsonl pass validate.py
scripts/split.py writes data/synth_train.jsonl, synth_val.jsonl, synth_test.jsonl (80/10/10) after dedup
every yes/no question has >= 10% yes-rate in synth_train
no state text appears in both train and a test set

userStories.title: Kaggle training kernel + smoke run
userStories.description: Private Kaggle kernel that installs Laya at the pinned commit, fine-tunes typed-decisions on our data, and evaluates zero-shot and trained per EVAL_PROTOCOL.md. Smoke run on 50 states.
acceptanceCriteria: kaggle/ holds the kernel source and metadata
smoke run completes on Kaggle and its output includes a metrics JSON with zero-shot and trained numbers
measured training throughput (examples/s) recorded in progress.txt

userStories.title: Full Kaggle run
userStories.description: Launch the full run sized from smoke throughput to finish by 08:30 CDT, checkpoint every epoch, evaluate zero-shot, trained and robustness in-notebook.
acceptanceCriteria: results/trained.json and results/robustness.json downloaded from the kernel output
REPORT.md has a Quality section with real_test and synth_test tables

userStories.title: Local zero-shot baseline
userStories.description: Score zero-shot typed-decisions on real_test and synth_test on this Mac as a cross-check of the notebook baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: results/baseline_local.json exists
REPORT.md notes agreement or disagreement with the notebook baseline

userStories.title: Final report
userStories.description: Apply EVAL_PROTOCOL.md decision rules. Friday answer and long-term answer, each with the numbers that decided it.
acceptanceCriteria: REPORT.md opens with the Friday verdict and the long-term verdict
every rule in EVAL_PROTOCOL.md is marked met, missed, or not evaluated with the reason
committed locally
